tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the tools, which need an API key, and the current price per call. Free; no key needed.

tools.name: find_podcasts
tools.description: Public podcasts whose name contains the text, most-transcribed first, with their slug (for the podcast filter of search_transcripts). Free; no key needed. At most 20 results.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Full-text search across transcripts: matching episodes with snippets, newest relevance first, 20 a page. Optional speaker person slug, podcast/topic slugs, publication year and UTC dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Speaker mode requires literal words/quoted phrases in one qualified passage and reports indexed cov

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Starts a cited answer drawn only from what was said on podcasts, or from one episode when episode_id (the pid of a search result) is given. Returns a job_id; call get_answer with it until status is complete (usually under a minute). Needs an API key; billed per question (see list_services).

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: The status and, once complete, the answer and its cited passages for a job from ask_question. Needs the API key that asked. Not billed.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: One episode's transcript, with speaker turns and timestamps, by podcast and episode id (the sid and pid of a search result). Only what the key's account may read. Needs an API key; billed per transcript (see list_services).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: The key's account balance and monthly allowance, and its calls and cost per day over the last 30 days. Needs an API key. Not billed.

tools.name: get_podcast
tools.description: Description, links, how many episodes are transcribed, the latest episode, and the price to transcribe an episode or subscribe. Free; no key needed.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: Episodes newest first, 25 a page: title, date, length, whether transcribed (with its link) and, if not, the price to transcribe it. Page 1 is free with no key; each later page needs a key and is billed at the catalog rate (list_services).

tools.name: analyze_feed
tools.description: Reads a public RSS feed (or Apple/Spotify link) and lists its episodes with which are already on Podgist and the price to transcribe the rest. Free; no key needed; at most 10 a minute.

tools.name: list_credit_tiers
tools.description: The AI-question credit packs and their prices. Free.

tools.name: get_topics
tools.description: This week's topics across podcasts, or one topic by slug. Free.

tools.name: find_topics
tools.description: Find up to10 currently public topic names and canonical slugs. Use a slug as the topic filter of search_transcripts. Free; no key needed.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Podgist's own news posts. Free.

tools.name: find_people
tools.description: People podcasts talk to and talk about, by name: slug, one-line descriptor and appearance counts. Free.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: One person's page data: bio, photo credit, counts, trend and the months with episodes; with month (YYYY-MM) and page, that month's episodes and how each names them. Free.

tools.name: quote_episode
tools.description: The price for this account to transcribe one episode (or, if transcribed, to read it), held 30 minutes. Needs a key with the "order" scope. Not billed; nothing is bought until order.

tools.name: quote_index
tools.description: The price to transcribe chosen episodes of a feed (episode ids from analyze_feed), with volume pricing. Needs a key with the "order" scope. Not billed until order.

tools.name: quote_credits
tools.description: A quote for one credit pack (tier from list_credit_tiers).

tools.name: quote_subscription
tools.description: A prepaid term of one month or year, paid from the balance, that never renews by itself: "podcast" (every transcript of one show), "all" (every transcript) or "professional" (all access plus the API).

tools.name: order
tools.description: Buys what a quote is for, charging its price to the account's prepaid API balance (never a card). At most $50 an order and $200 a day. Episodes that are never transcribed are refunded automatically. Needs the "order" scope.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One order and each episode's status (waiting, transcribed, refunded). Free.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: This account's orders paid from the API balance, newest first. Free.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Plan, subscriptions, AI credits, follows, purchases and summary-email settings, as the account page shows them. Free.

tools.name: list_follows
tools.description: The podcasts this account follows. Free.

tools.name: follow_podcast
tools.description: Follow a podcast (as the Follow button does). Needs the "account" scope. Free.

tools.name: unfollow_podcast
tools.description: Stop following a podcast. Needs the "account" scope. Free.

tools.name: list_people_follows
tools.description: Legacy alias of list_saved_alerts. The saved targets this account follows, with their latest episodes and alert settings. Free.

tools.name: follow_person
tools.description: Follow a person by slug (find_people), as the Follow button does. The free plan follows up to 3. Needs the "account" scope. Free.

tools.name: unfollow_person
tools.description: Stop following a person. Needs the "account" scope. Free.

tools.name: list_saved_alerts
tools.description: Canonical saved person/topic/literal phrase alerts, pause state, restore links and Following consent/cadence. Free.

tools.name: save_alert
tools.description: Save a person/topic slug or literal keyword phrase. RSS only by default; never enables Following consent. Paid email needs separate consent. Needs account scope. Free.

tools.name: update_alert
tools.description: Pause/resume a saved target or select email/RSS. Resume only matches future transcriptions; pause drops queued unsent alerts. Following cadence wins. Needs account scope. Free.

tools.name: remove_alert
tools.description: Remove this account’s saved target. Needs account scope. Free.

tools.name: set_email_settings
tools.description: Turn the summary email on or off, set daily or weekly and the weekly day, or include one followed podcast (podcast + enabled). Needs the "account" scope. Free.

tools.name: list_ask_history
tools.description: This account's questions, newest first, site and API alike. Free.

tools.name: delete_ask
tools.description: Remove a question from the Ask history (restore_ask puts it back). Needs the "account" scope.

tools.name: restore_ask
tools.description: Put a deleted question back in the Ask history. Needs the "account" scope.

tools.name: share_ask
tools.description: The public link to one of this account's answered questions.

tools.name: checkout_quote
tools.description: A checkout link for a person to pay this quote by card (when the balance or a cap stops order). The quote can then only be paid by that link; asking again returns the same link. Needs the "billing" scope.

tools.name: start_topup
tools.description: A checkout link for a person to add funds to the API balance by card; nothing is charged by the agent. The amount must be within the top-up limits list_services gives (orders.topup_min / topup_max). Needs the "billing" scope.

tools.name: billing_portal_link
tools.description: A link for a person to change the card, see invoices or cancel a card subscription. Needs the "billing" scope.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel the account's card-paid Professional plan at period end (provider "stripe", undo to keep it), or its PayPal subscription (provider "paypal"), exactly as the account page does. Prepaid terms bought with the balance never renew, so need no cancelling. Needs the "billing" scope.

tools.name: request_password_reset
tools.description: Email the account's address a password-reset code, as "Forgot password" does; the person sets the new password. Needs the "account" scope.

tools.name: revoke_this_key
tools.description: Revoke the API key making this call, for good. Other keys are managed only by the person.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_password_reset" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Email the account's address a password-reset code, as "Forgot password" does; the person sets the new password. Needs the "account" scope.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_transcripts, get_transcript, get_news, get_account · Private data: list_services, search_transcripts, ask_question, get_answer, get_transcript, get_usage, request_password_reset, revoke_this_key · Public sink: get_account, save_alert, update_alert, set_email_settings, share_ask, request_password_reset · Destructive: remove_alert, delete_ask, request_password_reset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_transcripts, get_transcript, get_news, get_account · Private data: list_services, search_transcripts, ask_question, get_answer, get_transcript, get_usage, request_password_reset, revoke_this_key · Public sink: get_account, save_alert, update_alert, set_email_settings, share_ask, request_password_reset · Destructive: remove_alert, delete_ask, request_password_reset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_transcripts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Full-text search across transcripts: matching episodes with snippets, newest relevance first, 20 a page. Optional podcast slug and date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Needs an API key; billed per search (see list_services)." → after: "Full-text search across transcripts: matching episodes with snippets, newest relevance first, 20 a page. Optional speaker person slug, podcast/topic slugs, publication year and UTC dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Speaker mode requires literal words/quoted phrases in one qualified passage and reports indexed cov"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
